provenance.readMethod: Read the original source text recorded by independent package CRC/SHA audit; no supplied JavaScript imported or executed.

contract.factory: buildNpcInkFragment({maxProfiles=64}) returns GLSL fragment source; accepted profile count2..64 with0 reserved.
contract.postprocess: textureSampler and vUV are the native Babylon color source; tNormal,tDepth,tSceneDepth,texel,nearFar,pixelWorldFactor,ink,npcProfiles,reverseDepth supplied by A manager.
contract.profile: tNormal.a=.5+profileIndex/128; decoded rounded index1..63; fixed WebGL1-safe loop selects vec2(height*worldScale,strength), default(1.85,.25).
contract.depth: Both textures are hardware nonlinear perspective depth0..1 with same camera near/far. reverseDepth reverses both before reconstruction/comparison.
contract.occlusion: Reject center AND every neighbor NPC sample behind main-scene depth by more than1e-6 raw depth; shared tolerance agreed with A for native self-depth precision.
contract.originalMath: Exact8edge samples:4axial and4diagonal .707 offsets; slope denominator max(.22,abs(n.z)); threshold=max(.0008*scale,z*pixelWorldFactor*1.4)+z*pixelWorldFactor*slope*1.8; depth smoothstep2.4; normal smoothstep(.16,.40)*.78; cutoff.035; alpha clamp0...9.
contract.composition: Linear mix(base.rgb,ink,alpha), preserve base.a. No duplicate gamma/color-space conversion. Background/occluded/weak-edge samples return original base color. No world pass/resources created by this pure module.

verification.format: Owned new files have LF EOF and no trailing spaces; git diff --check passes.
verification.limitations: Pure CPU/numerical/source verification only. No GPU shader compile, browser, pixel quality, foreground appearance or device performance claim. A owns native render target/depth/style lifecycle; C independent native integration remains required.
